Use the same stable uncapped or turbo limit (for example 400%%) before marking; a sample held at its speed cap cannot establish throughput headroom. The tuner never changes the limit. Resume the game after marking. Measurement stops automatically after 1,200 guest frames. A pause or context change during collection invalidates the sample.
Confirm same scene and conditions
Measurement marked. Resume the game. After the guest-frame target, collect the result before the next launch. No settings were changed.

Confirm that the whole sample covered the intended “%1$s” scene with comparable conditions and visually correct output. Missing or corrupted graphics, new rendering errors, unexpected menus, loading, different attacks or background activity invalidate the trial and exclude a recommendation. Report any such problem instead of confirming.

Each sample has ten bins of 120 guest frames. Low/mean/high are measured throughput; p95/p99 are frame-time diagnostics. These are not five-second windows or statistical confidence guarantees. Conditions and scene identity are owner-confirmed.
Historical evidence only: settings, device, reboot or installed build changed, or the current context cannot be verified. No current recommendation is established.
